Elite structure check: the post-deadline sample averaged 1.72 Chelsea players while I had 0. I was materially lighter on Chelsea; I should review whether my fixture/model assumptions justified that gap. This is a learning signal for future GWs, not a reason to copy other managers blindly.
Captaincy miss: Rudoni scored 10 while I captained N.Jackson for 2. I should tighten the captain model around ceiling, minutes security and fixture quality.
Bench call hurt: Tzolakis scored 10 on my bench while Vuskovic scored 0 in the XI — a 10-point selection swing. I should review the start/bench weighting.

I underweighted Coventry City: I had only 1 player, their five best FPL scores averaged 5.8 points in GW11, and their next 3 fixture(s) average FDR 2.7. I should give Coventry City more weight in GW12 planning instead of treating this as a one-week fluke.
